title: EQS 450+
driverAssistBrand: Mercedes-Benz Driver Assistance Package (DRIVE PILOT Level 3 conditionally automated highway driving is approved in Nevada and California only, not on this base trim)
infotainment: MBUX Hyperscreen optional (56-inch glass-spanning three-screen display: 12.3-inch driver, 17.7-inch center, 12.3-inch passenger); standard configuration uses single 12.8-inch OLED center plus 12.3-inch driver display. ZeroLayer voice control with 'Hey Mercedes' wake.
adasStandard: Active Brake Assist (AEB), Blind Spot Assist, Attention Assist, ABS, Traction Control, Hill Start Assist, Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function, lane keeping (Active Lane Keeping Assist). Source: https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/class/eqs/sedan
adasOptional: Driver Assistance Package (Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC adaptive cruise with stop-and-go, Active Steering Assist, Active Speed Limit Assist, Active Lane Change Assist, Evasive Steering Assist, Active Emergency Stop Assist), Surround View System with Active Parking Assist. Source: https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/class/eqs/sedan
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard. High-resolution camera with dynamic guidelines that bend with steering input. Integrated with surround-view as part of optional Parking Assist package. Source: https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/class/eqs/sedan
sideViewCameraNotes: Optional 360-degree Surround View System with Active Parking Assist. No dedicated Honda-LaneWatch-style side camera; relies on Blind Spot Assist via radar sensors. Source: https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/class/eqs/sedan
subscriptionFeatures: Acceleration Increase subscription: $1,200/year (or $60/mo) — electronically uncorks horsepower from base to higher tier (~+80hp, ~24% increase) on EQE 350 and EQS 450 models. Mercedes me Connect tiers include Remote Services, Navigation Services, Entertainment Services with subscription fees after initial trial. Source: https://www.techdirt.com/2022/11/28/mercedes-puts-faster-acceleration-behind-a-subscription-paywall/
drmNotes: Car operates fully without internet for driving functions. Connectivity required for: live traffic and navigation, Mercedes me Charge (including Tesla Supercharger Plug & Charge), OTA updates, remote app features. Source: https://www.mbusa.com/en/connect/connected-services
killSwitchNotes: No federal IIJA impaired-driving kill-switch yet implemented as of MY2025. Driver Attention Assist (drowsiness detection via steering inputs) is standard. Data unavailable: future implementation details specific to this trim.
knownIssues: Reported owner issues include: infotainment screen freezes / reboots, MBUX voice misrecognition, 12V auxiliary battery drain triggering warning lights, intermittent driver-assist faults, recurring software warning lights. Sources: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/mercedes-benz/eqs/2025/reliability/
recalls: 2 NHTSA recalls reported for MY2025 EQS Sedan as of early 2026 (software related). Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 Clean Vehicle Credit not available for MY2025 EQS Sedan due to North American final assembly requirement (EQS Sedan is built in Sindelfingen, Germany). However, the EQS Sedan qualifies for the IRA commercial-clean-vehicle credit when leased, which Mercedes-Benz Financial Services has been passing through as a lease incentive. State incentives vary; California CVRP ended Nov 2023. Sources: https://fueleconomy.gov/feg/taxevb.shtml
